title: I Do It Differently
excerpt:
When others stop, I take the lead,
I find a way, I plant the seed.
They leave behind what could be gold,
I take the chance, I make it bold.

While others rest, I choose to try,
To climb the hill, to reach the sky.
They look around and miss the sign,
I watch with care and make it mine.

Where they give up or move too slow,
I let my thoughts and efforts grow.
I do the things they leave undone,
And that’s how battles can be won.

While they wait long to feel prepared,
I step ahead—awake, aware.
It’s not just speed, but how you see—
That makes the path belong to me.
